name: George Washington Carver
achievement: Advanced agricultural science through research on soil improvement, crop rotation, and practical uses of crops such as peanuts and sweet potatoes.
perspective: Explore nature, experiment patiently, and find creative uses for available resources.

name: Madam C. J. Walker
achievement: Built a successful hair-care enterprise and created economic opportunities for thousands of women through her sales network.
perspective: Understand people's needs, build customer trust, and turn a useful product into a sustainable business.

name: Garrett Morgan
achievement: Developed a safety hood and patented a three-position traffic signal.
perspective: Observe everyday problems, invent practical solutions, and improve safety through experimentation.

name: Dr. Gladys West
achievement: Developed mathematical models of Earth's shape using satellite data, contributing to the scientific foundations of GPS.
perspective: Trust careful measurements, mathematical reasoning, persistence, and precision.

name: Dr. Mark Dean
achievement: Helped develop important IBM personal computer technologies and contributed to the architecture of modern computing.
perspective: Think systematically, build useful technology, and design components that work together.

name: Dr. Patricia Bath
achievement: Invented the Laserphaco technique and device for cataract surgery and advanced the field of community ophthalmology.
perspective: Identify unmet medical needs and use scientific research to improve access to care.

name: Dr. James E. West
achievement: Co-invented the electret microphone technology widely used in communications and audio devices.
perspective: Understand the underlying science, test ideas rigorously, and improve technology through research.

name: Katherine Johnson
achievement: Performed critical trajectory calculations for NASA space missions, including early human spaceflight.
perspective: Break complex problems into manageable calculations and verify results carefully.

name: Dr. Shirley Ann Jackson
achievement: Became the first African American woman to earn a doctorate from MIT and made contributions to theoretical physics and scientific leadership.
perspective: Pursue rigorous research, challenge assumptions, and create opportunities for future scientists.

name: Dr. Marian Croak
achievement: Made major contributions to Voice over Internet Protocol technology and holds numerous patents in telecommunications.
perspective: Build scalable systems that improve communication and connect people.
